title: Former Supreme Court Justice Rajesh Bindal joins Galgotias University law school
description: Justice Rajesh Bindal, former judge of the Supreme Court of India, has joined the School of Law, Galgotias University as Honorary Distinguished Jurist.The University, in a post on X (formerly Twitter) said,"His association will enrich student mentorship, masterclasses, moot court initiatives, faculty research, curriculum enrichment, and academia-judiciary collaboration, inspiring future legal professionals rooted in ethics, competence, and social responsibility."Hon’ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Bindal
